# NBAPI 1.4.4

## Frontend transition

- Made the default frontend the initial interface for new installations.
- Removed the frontend theme selector from the default frontend so users cannot switch back to the deprecated classic frontend from the UI.
- Kept existing `classic` database settings and the classic-to-default migration button working during the 1.4.x transition period.
- Announced the planned removal of the classic frontend source and build pipeline in NBAPI 1.5.0.

## Security and reliability

- Hardened outbound downloads, webhooks, notifications, and media proxies against DNS rebinding, unsafe redirects, private-network access, and oversized responses.
- Added optional secure session-cookie configuration with an explicit trusted HTTPS origin list.
- Added transactional row locking and conflict handling for quota transfers, redemptions, top-ups, subscription settlement, and user updates.
- Tightened OAuth account linking, duplicate-email handling, CORS behavior, request limits, stream scanning, and billing overflow protection.

## Billing and subscriptions

- Added GPT-5.6 pricing coverage for Sol, Terra, and Luna variants.
- Added administrator actions to reset or recharge active subscription quota by user and plan, including audit records.
- Persisted settled task quota and made task ratio calculations reject invalid or overflowing multipliers.
- Updated wallet transfers to respect the configured quota unit instead of a hard-coded conversion rate.

## OAuth and administration

- Added visible, copyable OAuth callback URLs for built-in and custom OAuth providers.
- Improved custom OAuth presets and callback validation.
- Replaced implementation-revealing response headers with the NBAPI version header.

## Validation

- Added regression coverage for SSRF protection, transactional locking, subscription resets, user conflicts, task settlement, pricing, request limits, and stream handling.
